plainTranslation: Composite Pluto in the 6 House: With Composite Pluto in the 6th house, you may struggle over power and control in your daily life together. You can fight over the little things, 97/ ​© The Dark Pixie Astrology and you may not fight a lot, but you bottle it up until it explodes out and you have complete resentment of one another. Avoid that by being more open. In a professional relationship, one of you may have all of the power, and this can cause many problems.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
